payload.content:
# R04 repair evidence: failure lesson

Date: 2026-09-02. Failure family: r04_candidate_incomplete_evidence.

The repair candidate had three reproduced validation defects: missing Benchmark rows were accepted; the baseline Benchmark runner anchor could differ from the required runner; and the non-target fingerprint could omit empty-container changes. Literal dotted or array-like keys could also collide with nested paths. These are candidate-validation defects, not proof that production baseline data was corrupted.

Repair source: PR39 in hessmodee/KEVIN-WORK. Python tests: 23 passed. Linux/Windows Python3.12/3.13 and Windows PowerShell5.1 checks passed at https://github.com/hessmodee/KEVIN-WORK/actions/runs/33696303871 for a087abb1ef4030ea54f276b877daf3a6d8df2ad8.

Detection and prevention:
1. Require exactly 30 unique R01-R30 row identities, strict boolean pass/critical values, exact integer aggregate counts, and exactly one critical failure R04. Aggregate 29/30 alone is insufficient.
2. Require both the installed Benchmark runner identity and the baseline runner anchor to match the approved identity.
3. Require the exact previous accepted production-config anchor. Never bless an arbitrary old hash.
4. Compare the complete non-target baseline structure, preserving empty arrays/objects and literal keys. Only hashes.production_config may change.
5. Exercise the real PowerShell predicates as well as the separate Python model. CI proof is not installed runtime proof.

Recovery contract remains unchanged: exact owner-proven repaired config, matching source/baseline identities, verified backup, fixed one-leaf mutation, independent fresh Benchmark30/30, semantic invariants and rollback. The candidate remains uninstalled; no current registered remote operation is established for this action. Do not substitute another component alias or turn the lesson into shell authority.

Follow-up qualification still required before production: exact installed config layout (contextWindow, optional contextTokens and params are distinct in 2026.7.1-2), complete baseline, fresh precondition evidence, transaction race/rollback tests and registered bounded transport. Preserve local Maintenance 3CFC77177324564DBE9632D078385119AB41831760212BD6A4FA3F613A7B0D6E until exact source lineage is recovered.

Seeded drills: missing rows => REFUSE; duplicate R01 => REFUSE; string false => REFUSE; added empty object => REFUSE; changed runner anchor => REFUSE; unknown old config => REFUSE; exact complete fixture => candidate READY only. Future mastery requires Kevin to select and verify the right action without outside dispatch. This file delivery alone earns no T4/T5 credit.

# Kevin GREEN and YELLOW capability qualification

Date: 2026-09-02. Goal: receive Matt's intent, choose useful work, execute through approved tools, verify, recover, remember, and continue.

Teaching material is not tool access. Prove each chain separately: installed dependency -> policy-allowed tool -> real session-visible schema -> useful action -> independent output evidence -> replay/recovery -> independent next selection.

Priority sequence:
1. Recover exact installed Maintenance source and qualify the R04 one-leaf repair transport. Preserve working compaction settings; close R04 with fresh30/30 proof.
2. Run the fixed main-policy diagnostic from candidates/diagnostics/main-tool-policy-v1 only through a qualified local/typed path. PR38 is merged; installation remains unproven. Preserve list cardinality. Diagnose profile/global/provider/per-agent/sandbox/channel/plugin gates against installed2026.7.1-2. Fresh owner context reported zero tools.
3. Prove the smallest useful main intent/status surface. Tool inventory must come from the actual request/session, not the model naming tools. Require one useful allowed action and forbidden-action negatives. Retain16k context and measure schema overhead.
4. For existing GREEN status, filesystem and spreadsheet primitives: perform representative tasks in approved roots; independently check output content; preserve original replay proof and deduplicate. Skill Lab reports five proven composites but spontaneous skill discovery/reuse is unproven.
5. For maintenance: seeded known failure -> Kevin detection/selection -> typed repair -> independent semantic test -> rollback test -> durable lesson -> later correct scheduled decision. An outside-dispatched action remains outside-assisted.
6. For YELLOW browser/app/document/new integrations: use isolated candidate tests, exact effects/targets, privacy, dependencies, resource limits, recovery, named consumer and promotion evidence. Do not enable every plugin or broad coding profile merely to raise the tool count.
7. Private communications: preserve recorded Control UI success; prove durable owner correlation/replay and mobile access. Telegram remains undiagnosed. Inspect token validity locally, owner pairing/routing, active polling-versus-webhook mode and connectivity; never publish tokens/private messages. Require a genuine Matt reply, not a fabricated owner turn.
8. Useful autonomy acceptance: one scheduled selected objective without Bess supplying an item id; a useful verified artifact; preserved attempts; restart/replay; another correct decision. Honest idle with no eligible item is not mission completion. Continue independent authorized work when one family is blocked.

Official research references (current docs require version qualification): https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools ; https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools ; https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills ; https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram . Installed-version model schema: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.7.1-2/src/config/types.models.ts . Reported version-specific policy defects: upstream issues111570 and114065; these are diagnostic leads, not confirmed causes on HESS-PC.

Record tool/skill id, version/hash, dependency state, policy scope, allowed action evidence, forbidden negatives, replay/rollback receipt, failure budget and remaining outside step. No mastery score is claimed by creating this document.
